requirements.text: Proven AI Engineering Experience: Demonstrated track record of shipping production-level software with autonomous LLM agents or workflows at its core
Product & AI Engineering: Design, build, and deploy agent-centric software architectures and end-to-end AI workflows beyond basic conversational interfaces

End-to-End Feature Ownership: Manage the full product development lifecycle—from sitting directly with end-users to understand core pain points, through architectural design, implementation, and deployment

Agent Evaluation & Harnessing: Develop, maintain, and defend robust evaluation frameworks, harness selections, and context management strategies (context window optimization, filtering, and retrieval)
Continuous Paradigm Evaluation: Actively benchmark, test, and re-evaluate emerging LLM models, frameworks, and agent paradigms to continuously refine and improve system performance
Fast Learning & Domain Synthesis: Capability to rapidly absorb complex domain expertise (e.g., financial underwriting or commercial real estate logic) and translate it into technical specifications
On-Site Availability: Ability to work full-time on-site, five days a week, at the SoHo, NYC office
